changelog:
Initial release of docx-footnote-reader.

- Extracts footnotes, endnotes, and body text from .docx files.
- Supports both command line and Node.js API usage.
- Handles different return formats from underlying word-extractor library.
- Filters and trims empty or whitespace-only notes.
- Designed for technical, legal, and academic documents where footnote content is important.
summary: Extract footnotes, endnotes, and body text from .docx files using Node.js. Use this skill when you need to read footnote/endnote content from Word documents,...
